en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 remains; Saudel now a tropical storm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said Tropical Storm Saudel was about 250 km east-southeast of the territory early Wednesday and the chance of a Strong Wind Signal stays relatively low.
body: The Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force early Wednesday as Tropical Storm Saudel continued to edge closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong.

According to the Hong Kong Observatory, at around 2 a.m. Saudel was estimated to be about 250 kilometres east-southeast of Hong Kong and was forecast to move northeast across the northern part of the South China Sea.

The Observatory said Saudel’s outer rainbands would bring squally showers, and local winds would be occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. Unless the system intensifies significantly and its strong-wind zone moves closer to the Pearl River Estuary, the chance of strong winds generally over Hong Kong is not high.

The chance of issuing the Strong Wind Signal No. 3 on Wednesday was described as relatively low. The Standby Signal is expected to remain in force through Wednesday morning. The Observatory added that Saudel may linger near the northeastern South China Sea and the eastern Guangdong coast on Thursday, with rather large uncertainties in its later track and intensity, so tropical cyclone warning signals could stay in force until later in the week.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號維持 沙德爾已增強為熱帶風暴
zh.dek: 天文台表示，熱帶風暴沙德爾周三凌晨位於本港東南偏東約250公里，改發三號強風信號機會仍相對較低。
body: 一號戒備信號周三凌晨繼續生效，熱帶風暴沙德爾正逐漸靠近廣東東部沿岸。
天文台表示，沙德爾於凌晨約2時估計集結在香港東南偏東約250公里，預料向東北移動，橫過南海北部。
天文台指，沙德爾的外圍雨帶會為本港帶來狂風驟雨，離岸及高地間中吹強風。除非沙德爾顯著增強及其相關強風區更接近珠江口一帶，否則本港普遍吹強風的機會不大。
天文台預料周三改發三號強風信號的機會相對較低，一號戒備信號會在周三早上維持。按現時預測，沙德爾周四會在南海東北部及廣東東部沿岸一帶徘徊，其後路徑及強度仍有相當變數，熱帶氣旋警告信號可能需維持至本周後期。
